Select compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Source molecule_dictionary, molecule_hierarchy, compound_records, compound_structures, activities, docs, assays, target_dictionary. Join molecule_hierarchy on parent_molregno from parent molecule_dictionary CHEMBL1336 to get child molregnos. Join compound_records on molregno. Join compound_structures on molregno. Join activities on record_id. Join docs on doc_id. Join assays on assay_id. Join target_dictionary on tid. Filter parent chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1336'. Include parent row by joining hierarchy where molregno = parent_molregno. Filter target chembl_id = 'CHEMBL279'. Filter standard_type = 'IC50'. Filter standard_units = 'nM'. Sort by compound_chembl_id, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism.
